observations.why: Establishing a recurring cadence appeals to stability and security (conservation) while framing rehearsals as ongoing mastery (competence).

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Equating unrehearsed with non-existent frames capability-as-possession: only practiced readiness counts as real, appealing to competence and the security of verified preparedness.
Restating the cadence as a labeled property reinforces the stability and regularity the directive establishes.
Naming an owner assigns self-origination and accountability for the rehearsal program, appealing to autonomy as the good of owning one's domain.
